publisher: Laurens County SC zoning copy (ArcGIS Online item by mwassonfigis)
notes: Not an official county service: Laurens County SC has no zoning ordinance per its planning page. This is layer 4 (Laurens Zoning - 10/21/2023) of a personal ArcGIS Online item by mwassonfigis (Greenville and Laurens County zoning data), 87 polygons. The district codes (C-2, I-1, R-10, R-12, R-7.5, R-M, O/S) resemble City of Laurens zoning, but the layer has no jurisdiction field, so which jurisdictions it covers is unverified. Official city zoning map is a PDF only (cityoflaurenssc.com/zoningmap).
